race.comment: KINGSTON CHARM (7) has a good record at this course and distance and indicated she was near her top when third over 1600m at Warwick Farm. Can race a touch closer from the rails draw and must be kept safe. CRYPTONIC (1) jumped in grade and trip with a battling ninth over 1600m at Warwick Farm in BM72 class. Assess on his fighting second here two back over the 1400m. Will race on the speed and take catching. MALBORK CASTLE (6) undefeated at this track and finds an easier race. Failed to kale any real impression when eighth over 1400m in a BM72 at Warwick Farm. Zac Lloyd hops on and will keep improving as he gets out in trip. TOM CRUISING (5) rounded up a handy field two back when saluting at Kembla Grange over 15600m. Couldn't follow that up last time out when snagged back from the draw to finish a dismal sixth over 1600m at Kembla Grange. Hard fit and stays in the mix.
